name: Hugging Face
description: Hugging Face's hosted server searches models, datasets, papers and Spaces. Signing in lets it reach your own models, datasets and Spaces as well as public ones.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (huggingface.co) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
